recordSource: SELECT Tmp_Dejun.* FROM Tmp_Dejun ORDER BY Tmp_Dejun.Tip;

controls.rs: SELECT Feluri.Felul AS Expr1 FROM Feluri WHERE ((([Feluri].[Felul]) Not In (select Tip from [Tmp_Dejun])));

SELECT X.DenFel, X.IdFel, IIf([idfel]<>0,"REȚETAR","=") AS Expr1 FROM (SELECT DenFel, IdFel FROM Felurimancare GROUP BY DenFel, IdFel UNION ALL SELECT Dejun.Explicatie, 0 FROM Dejun WHERE (((Dejun.Tip) Like [Forms]![ListaAlimente]![mdv])) GROUP BY Dejun.Explicatie, 0 UNION ALL select tmp_Dejun.Explicatie, 0 from tmp_Dejun WHERE tip like [Forms]![ListaAlimente]![mdv])  AS X WHERE (((X.DenFel)<>"")) ORDER BY X.IdFel DESC , X.DenFel;
